concepts.definition: the ability to perform daily and sporting activities effectively without undue fatigue
the ability to sustain physical activity over an extended period
the ability of a muscle or muscle group to exert force against resistance
the ability of a joint to move through an effective range of motion
the ability to use different body parts together smoothly and efficiently
light preparatory activity that gradually readies the body for more vigorous exercise
gentle activity after exercise that helps the body return gradually toward its resting state
immediate basic care given to an injured or suddenly ill person before full medical treatment
competitive track and field activities involving running, jumping, and throwing
a sport in which participants cooperate as a group against another group under agreed rules
